text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was waiting for <chrname> to arrive at the grounds...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks painful!
Flash-san, what happened to your nail?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It chipped during physical education class...
It is nothing of serious concern.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, you really shouldn't underestimate it.
I've got tools on me, wanna let me repair it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is insufficient time for that.
We are under three minutes before our scheduled tandem run.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Following the tandem run, we have joint dance practice, so nail maintenance must wait until after.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... You're really putting it off that long?
If it gets worse, you're seriously screwed.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about this? If I win our match race,
you gotta let me take care of those nails, deal?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Very well... In that case, if I win,
I shall carry out my schedule exactly as planned.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez... You really shouldn't underestimate
the power of proper nail care!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toosen Jordan and Eishin Flash.
Their match race remained neck-and-neck all the way to the final straight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Eishin Flash began her final spurt,
she clenched her fists tightly.
And at that exact moment—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
I... I won!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Flash-san!
Didn't you totally yell 'ouch' at the very end there?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Just a bit... It seems I clenched my fists too hard.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
See? Told ya so!
You really can't just leave your nails like that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is just as you said.
I shall prioritize taking care of my nails.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
As long as you get it, we're good!
Alright, let's get this done quick~.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Aand, all done!
Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I am astonished.
They are not merely beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even when I clench my fists with full force, it doesn't hurt at all...
With this, I will be able to give my absolute all in the final spurt.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right~?
I'm basically a pro at this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. 
By the way, what kind of tools did you...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, don't look!
That's, like, a trade secret!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The nail product Toosen Jordan tried to hide
rolls across the floor.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Sports nail polish, is it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Your nail art was not mere decoration—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was a secret measure to unleash your full power
in races decided by fractions of a second.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's really not like that...
You're giving me way too much credit...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. I truly appreciate you teaching me
this fact firsthand through your actions.
choice_data_list: It's fashionable and practical, what a great combo.
Being that serious about winning is really cool.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, yeah, exactly.
You can shower me with respect, you know?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall take this into account.
I will be sure to repay this favor.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I know! I plan to bake Schneeballen tomorrow,
so please, do have some.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seriously? That sounds fancy as hell.
I'm totally looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...L-Look, it's strictly about 'fashion,' okay?
Don't get that twisted.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Argh, I'm just so exhausted!
I'm gonna go buy some new nail polish colors~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Balancing practical utility with aesthetic elegance...
Indeed, I have learned a valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No no no, none of that hot-blooded stuff, okay?! None!
I just do it because I like pretty nails...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I smell it, oh yes I do...!
That's the unmistakable scent of someone having a full-blown youthful rom-com moment!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what the heck out of nowhere...
Ugh, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aha~! Look what we have here, someone blushing up a storm!
Is it this one? Is this punk the culprit?!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what is this nonsense?!
You're so annoying!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Suspect on the run!
Aw yeah, time for Ace Detective Golshi-sama to show her stuff!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san seems troubled being chased around by Golshi-san...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now is the time to repay the favor!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After being rescued, Toosen Jordan was heard saying,
'Turns out doing someone a solid really does come back around...'
Or so the story goes.
